old_description: based in Denver, Colorado. We were founded upon the desire to provide reasonably priced, high quality manufactured metal products and to keep manufacturing in America. With a strong management team and a knowledgeable manufacturing group, Monarch has risen to be one of the industry leaders. From prototype through production, we are committed to offering a seamless solution to give our customers the parts they need to succeed.
about:
Monarch Metal Manufacturing operates from a facility in Denver, Colorado. The company was founded in 2007 with the stated goal of providing reasonably priced, high-quality metal products while keeping manufacturing in the United States. No founder names or ownership structure (family, veteran, or woman-owned) are disclosed in public materials.

The shop delivers precision fabrication, precision machining, hardware insertion, and mechanical assembly, managing the full manufacturing sequence from programming through final assembly. Stamping work is outsourced. The 60-person team works in a Denver facility that supports prototype through production runs, positioning the company as a single-source provider for metal components.

Monarch serves customers across industries requiring precision metal parts, though specific sectors are not named in its public materials. The company emphasizes a team-based approach and open communication on production status, aiming to build partnerships that take products from print to finished part with minimal disruption.

Differentiators cited by the company include an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, advanced scheduling and stocking programs to meet lead-time requirements, and a commitment to domestic manufacturing. The quality policy stresses continuous improvement and adherence to procedures on every job.

Whether you’re launching custom, high-quality supplements for the first time or seeking to reformulate existing products with cutting-edge ingredients, we are dedicated to supporting your journey every step of the way.
about:
Montana Global Health was formed in 2019 as a privately-owned dietary supplement contract manufacturer in Kalispell, Montana. The company was established to serve brand owners seeking custom supplement manufacturing with a focus on quality and accessibility.

The company specializes in multiple delivery formats including capsules, daily dose packs, sachets, stick packs, liquids, powders, and pet supplements. Its capabilities include high-speed encapsulation and state-of-the-art packaging. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Montana Global Health serves the dietary supplement and pet supplement industries, working with brand owners of all sizes from startups to large companies. The company emphasizes lower minimum order quantities to accommodate smaller businesses.

The company states its mission is to be the most quality-attractive dietary supplement manufacturer in the Northwestern U.S., differentiating itself through reduced turnaround times, regular order-status communication, sourcing of high-quality raw ingredients, and lower minimums compared to competitors. It adheres to cGMP regulations under FDA 21 CFR Part 111.

name: Moses Lake Industries
old_description: From semiconductors to advanced technologies, MLI pushes the limits of possibility. Our world-class R&D laboratories, led by industry experts, collaborate closely with leading chip manufacturers to develop next-generation solutions that enable cutting-edge device production. Since 1984, we have combined innovation with reliability to support the technologies shaping tomorrow.
about:
Founded in 1984 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Tama Chemicals, Moses Lake Industries (MLI) operates its global headquarters in Moses Lake, Washington, with additional operations in Mesa, Arizona. The company began with a single product and a founder's vision to build an enduring enterprise for future generations.

MLI develops and manufactures ultra-high-purity chemistries for the semiconductor industry, offering a portfolio that has grown to over 1,000 products. Its capabilities span advanced packaging, IC substrate, Damascene, TMAH, and analytical reagent formulations. The company provides localized manufacturing, technical support, R&D services, and distribution through multiple plants worldwide. In-house raw material synthesis, proprietary manufacturing systems designed and managed by internal experts, real-time analytical monitoring, and strict packaging and shipping controls underpin its production process.

The company serves semiconductor manufacturers and advanced technology firms, collaborating closely with leading chip makers to develop next-generation solutions. Its customer base includes global semiconductor fabs requiring high-performance chemical solutions for cutting-edge device production.

MLI differentiates itself through a quality operating system built on Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), in-house raw material production, and a Certificate of Analysis provided with every shipment. The founder's original vision—to create a lasting enterprise invested in people, community, and environment—continues to drive its focus on innovative, operational, and financial excellence.

name: Motherlode Co-Packing Corporate Offices
old_description: Located 30 min from the Denver International Airport, our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility is FDA/HACCP/SQF approved, and we are fully equipped for both food service and retail sizes to help you expand your brand. Our talented crew has more than 60 years of experience in food manufacturing and sales. We offer a variety of glass and plastic options for your sauce, syrup, dressing, or condiment.
about:
Motherlode Co-Packing operates from Hudson, Colorado, about 30 minutes from Denver International Airport. The company was founded in 1966 and has grown into a certified co-packing facility serving food brands nationwide. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and the original founders are not named in available sources.

The facility provides end-to-end co-packing services for sauces, syrups, dressings, condiments, and beverages. Its process covers formulation development with food scientists, bottling in glass, plastic, or pouch formats, and automation for scale-up. The plant is FDA, HACCP, and SQF approved and runs thousands of gallons per week. Specific facility size and headcount are not published.

Motherlode works with established food brands on both coasts that are poised for sales growth. Customers include sauce and condiment companies, a vegan food brand, and a restauranteur launching a sauce line. The company also connects brands with its investor network for capital raises and leverages a vendor rolodex for supply chain support.

The company emphasizes transformative relationships, integrity, and innovative processes. It was voted 2021 Colorado Food Manufacturer of the Year and holds a 99/100 food safety rating. All ingredients used are non-GMO. Motherlode differentiates itself by offering integrated capital, logistics, and value-engineering services alongside core co-packing.

name: Msi Mold Builders
old_description: Since 1971, MSI has been dedicated to being our customers’ competitive advantage. Industries around the world have turned to MSI to design and build molds of exceptional accuracy and durability. We do this by taking the time to understand each of our customer’s unique needs and by creating a culture that’s driven by the following attributes:
about:
MSI Mold Builders was founded in 1971 by Ed and CharLes Klouda in Swisher, Iowa, as a family-owned mold building and servicing operation. The company relocated to a 35,000-square-foot headquarters in Cedar Rapids in 1990 and added a 20,000-square-foot facility in Greenville, South Carolina, in 2001. A 12,000-square-foot expansion in Cedar Rapids followed in 2015. Now in its third generation, the business is led by CEO Roger Klouda and President Kyle Klouda.

The company designs and builds steel and aluminum injection molds for processes including structural foam, reaction injection molding (RIM), blow molding, gas assist, and structural web, as well as aluminum tooling for limited production. MSI specializes in large-tonnage molds weighing up to 150,000 pounds, supported by two U.S. facilities totaling over 67,000 square feet. Since 1971, the firm has delivered thousands of molds across a range of sizes and complexities, offering end-to-end services from design and engineering through in-house sampling, repair, and preventative maintenance.

MSI serves OEMs and suppliers in automotive, power sports, agriculture, lawn and garden, medical equipment, heavy truck, material handling, recreational vehicles, construction, office furniture, solar, energy distribution, infrastructure, data centers, and appliance industries. Notable projects include tooling for the AxSYM medical program and reusable pallets for the solar industry.

The company emphasizes a process-driven approach rooted in Lean Manufacturing, with early data validation, cross-functional design reviews, and in-process quality checks to reduce risk and ensure repeatable lead times. Domestic production is positioned to shorten supply chains, improve communication, and enable faster design changes and on-site collaboration.

name: NEP | Custom Cable Assembly Manufacturer
old_description: Panduit specializes in electrical and network infrastructure solutions, including wire management systems, connectors, and cable ties. We use Panduit products in our manufacturing assemblies to deliver durable, efficient, and organized solutions that meet the high standards of various industries.
about:
NEP was founded in 1977 by Bill Federighi and Tom Lotus, two former regional sales managers who saw a need for a customer-first approach in the electronics industry. The company began as NEP Electronics, a distribution business in Chicago, Illinois, and moved to a 35,000-square-foot facility in Wood Dale, Illinois, in 1988. A 40,000-square-foot manufacturing building was added next door in 2009, and a 2025 expansion brought an additional 10,000 square feet of production space and 5,000 square feet of offices to the Wood Dale campus.

Today NEP provides custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, electro-mechanical assemblies, and full contract manufacturing including box builds, panel and enclosure assembly, and system integration. Its capabilities cover wire processing from 32 AWG to 4/0, high-speed robotic cutting, stripping, crimping, tinning, and printing, multi-stage coaxial processing, and hydraulic crimping for battery and welding cables. The company operates with a workforce that includes more than 40 employees who have been with the firm for over a decade, supporting prototype through high-volume production runs.

NEP serves a range of industries including agriculture, food processing, gaming and coin-operated equipment, industrial equipment, medical devices, robotics, transportation, and utility/energy sectors. Customers also come from technology and communications markets, as reflected in testimonials from buyers in those fields.

The company differentiates itself through vertical integration that combines franchised component distribution (45+ lines) with engineering support, first-article verification, DFM analysis, and rigorous quality testing including 100% continuity, hi-pot, and terminal pull tests. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification, UL recognition, and ITAR compliance, and offers vendor-managed inventory and just-in-time delivery programs.

name: Neaton Auto Products Manufacturing
old_description: Neaton Auto Products Manufacturing, Inc. is a Tier 1 automotive supplier and a wholly owned subsidiary of Nihon Plast Co., Ltd., a global leader in safety and trim systems. Founded in 1984 and headquartered in Eaton, Ohio, Neaton supports major OEMs across North America with a commitment to innovation, quality, and operational excellence.
about:
Neaton Auto Products Manufacturing was founded in 1984 in Eaton, Ohio, as a wholly owned subsidiary of Japan's Nihon Plast Co., Ltd., a global leader in safety and trim systems. The company operates as a Tier 1 automotive supplier serving major OEMs across North America.

The company designs and manufactures steering wheels, airbag modules, decorative interior trim, exterior components, resin parts, leather-wrapped steering wheels, and magnesium components. Its manufacturing processes include injection molding, blow molding, painting, welding, assembly, wrapping, sewing, and reaction injection molding (RIM). The primary Eaton campus spans over 565,000 square feet of production space, with additional U.S. facilities in Marysville, Ohio (sales and technical support) and Rome, Georgia (painting, assembly, and cockpit trim). Operations extend to multiple sites in Mexico and a network of Nihon Plast plants in China, Vietnam, Thailand, and Indonesia. North American sales exceeded $300 million in 2023.

Neaton serves the automotive industry, specifically major OEMs requiring safety systems such as airbag modules and steering wheels, as well as interior and exterior trim components. Its customer base includes leading automakers across North America, supported by deep integration with OEM platforms and end-to-end product development from tooling to final assembly.

The company emphasizes decades of technical expertise in safety systems, decorative trim, and blow-molded parts, along with on-site design support and IATF 16949-certified quality systems. President Takeshi (Casey) Toyota states the business is built by and for its associates, aiming to bring smiles to employees, customers, and communities.

name: New England Fabricated Metals
old_description: New England Fabricated Metals, Inc., NEFM, is a sheet metal fabrication and precision machining manufacturer producing top-notch solutions for leading OEMs and contract manufacturers across industries. Our company has been in business since 1983 and our team is made up of experts in the sheet metal fabrication industry. We are continuously growing with the landscape of the industry and offer customers unique and innovative fabricated metal solutions.
about:
New England Fabricated Metals, Inc. (NEFM) has operated from Leominster, Massachusetts since its founding in 1983. The company serves as a sheet metal fabrication and precision machining manufacturer for original equipment manufacturers and contract manufacturers across multiple sectors.

NEFM provides start-to-finish metal fabrication services including sheet metal forming, brake press bending, welding, machining, hardware insertion, mechanical assembly, and finishing. The facility also offers 3D/SLA printing, engineering support, prototyping, quality inspection, inventory management, and shipping. The company reports an annual output of approximately 200,000 pieces with a 99 percent product conformity rate.

The manufacturer works primarily with medical sterilization and medical technology companies, alongside other OEMs and contract manufacturers. A noted collaboration includes Sunrise Labs, where NEFM delivered a complex weldment on a tight schedule after a previous vendor failed.

NEFM differentiates itself through a combined team experience exceeding 400 years, a dedicated management presence on the production floor, and a quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015. The company is also ITAR registered and emphasizes eliminating middlemen by handling projects from design through kitting.

name: NuWay Electronics
old_description: NuWay has been providing tape and reel service since 1975 and remains a leader in quality, service, turn-around time, and depth of capabilities. Let us apply our years of experience in tape and reel packaging to help you maximize the advantages of automation in electronics manufacturing.
about:
NuWay Electronics, based in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, was founded in 1975 as a provider of tape and reel packaging services. The privately held company, now led by President Doug Hamilton, began with a focus on tape and reel packaging for the electronics industry and has since expanded into cable assembly and component services.

The company offers cable assembly, tape and reel packaging (including surface mount, radial, and axial configurations), and component services such as lead forming and trimming, baking and dry packing, and sealing and coating. NuWay also manufactures UL- and FM-listed devices and operates with a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015. Its workforce includes numerous employees with more than 20 years of tenure.

NuWay serves contract manufacturers and OEMs across sectors including clean energy, data centers, and stamped or machined electronic components. The company's Chicago-area location provides access to major transportation networks.

NuWay emphasizes its long-standing experience, 100% inspection of tape and reel services, and a commitment to tailoring solutions to customer needs. The company cites its ISO 9001:2015 certification, UL and FM listings, and memberships in SMTA and IPC as foundations of its quality culture.

name: O'Donnell Metal Fabricators, Inc.
old_description: Since 1981, O’Donnell Metal Fabricators Inc. has served as an all-encompassing design and fabrication partner dedicated to helping individuals and businesses enhance their products from concept to creation. With our fully in-house approach, every process is handled by our specialized departments, all of which adhere to the rigorous standards and procedures set by ODMF. This consistency ensures quality parts, streamlined communication, and outcomes that build client success.
about:
O'Donnell Metal Fabricators, Inc. was founded in 1981 in Norristown, Pennsylvania, as a family-owned, American-made metal fabrication shop. The company began as a design and fabrication partner for OEMs, contractors, and plant managers, and has remained in the same location for over four decades.

The shop provides fully in-house metal fabrication, including CNC fiber laser cutting (up to 1-inch mild steel), CNC plasma cutting (up to 4-inch thick stainless, carbon steel, and aluminum), press brake forming with a 175-ton Cincinnati press brake (12-foot bed, 60-by-144-inch max sheet), shearing, sheet rolling (hot and cold), punch press work, welding (MIG, TIG, stick), and finishing such as powder coating and zinc plating. Production runs from single prototypes to full-scale volumes, with a stated laser tolerance of ±0.005 inch.

The company serves aerospace, automotive, military and defense, manufacturing, oil and energy, medical and pharmaceutical, facility maintenance, agriculture, food processing, construction, food service, hospitality, and commercial kitchen sectors. Customers include OEMs, engineers, architects, and contractors across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, and Maryland.

O'Donnell differentiates itself through value engineering to reduce cost and improve function, a single-roof process that eliminates vendor handoffs, dedicated project managers who maintain visibility at every stage, and certifications that include AWS, NSF, and UL. The family-owned structure emphasizes competitive pricing, short lead times, and integrity throughout each build.
